subject: MAP Draft: contract edit roster + proposed 72h TAT for legal redlines
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amelia Stone <amelia.stone@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Draft: contract edit roster + proposed 72h TAT for legal redlines

Team — thanks for a productive discovery earlier. I promised to circulate a short MAP draft that captures milestones, who owns contract redlines for the MSA/DPA/SLA milestone, and proposed turnaround times so ACME has clarity on expectations. Attaching a spreadsheet with the milestone grid (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) and a copy of the latest MSA with ACME’s initial annotations (MSA-redlines-acme.pdf).

Quick summary of the legal milestone (high level):
- Objective: Get to mutually agreed MSA + DPA + SLA language for production launch.
- Target close date for this milestone: 2027-06-10 (customer target).
- Critical dependencies: security questionnaire (SSQ) completion, procurement PO, and SOC-2 evidence.

Proposed owner roster and TAT for redlines:
- Initial inbound redline packet from ACME (received): ACME Legal -> we acknowledge within 24 hours.
- Redwood initial pass (who: Naomi / Legal): 48–72 hours for a first-pass disposition (accept/modify/comment).
- Sales coordination and commercial trade-offs (who: Ben / Sales): Sales to confirm non-legal commercial asks in 24 hours of Naomi’s pass.
- Technical exceptions (who: Karthik / Eng): Detailed technical responses for SSO/KMS/data flow within 3 business days of Naomi’s pass.
- Counter-redline window from ACME: request 5 business days.

Asks:
1) Naomi — can you confirm the 48–72h SLA for an initial legal pass is doable if we get the inbound packet by EOD tomorrow? If not, propose an alternate TAT.
2) Ben — please confirm you'll own commercial concessions and pricing trade-offs; if any credit/discount escalations arise, you’ll route to me for approval.
3) Karthik — flag any items likely to need >3 business days so we can set expectations with ACME up front (e.g., custom encryption key flow / on-prem connectors).

I’ll draft the email to ACME after we agree internally and will propose the explicit MAP milestone row: owner fields, dates, and fallback escalation (Naomi -> Jordan -> VP Sales).

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0148

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: contract edit roster + proposed 72h TAT for legal redlines

Thanks Jordan — I reviewed the attachments quickly. 48–72h for an initial pass is reasonable provided the inbound packet includes: the redline PDF, a short summary of priority clauses (3 bullets), and any requested SLA numbers.

Notes / constraints:
- If ACME pushes non-standard indemnity or data residency language, we’ll need to loop in privacy counsel; that will add time (estimate +3–5 business days).
- DPA-specific controls that reference third-party certs may require SRE/engineering confirmation.

I’ll commit to: initial pass within 72 hours of receiving a complete packet. I’ll tag changes with one-line rationale and proposed fallback language where possible. If I identify anything that materially expands risk, I’ll escalate to Jordan immediately.

Attachment: I added a short "legal-review-checklist.txt" to the Drive link.

—Naomi Feldman
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com

From: Amelia Stone <amelia.stone@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, ACME Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: contract edit roster + proposed 72h TAT for legal redlines

Jordan — thanks for the clear breakdown. Good to see proposed TATs; ACME is aligned on the target close date but we have two asks to surface up front: 

1) Can Redwood commit to the 72h initial pass? ACME Legal is on a tight review schedule and needs an explicit SLA for the first disposition so we can meet internal sign-off windows.
2) On the DPA we may request stronger data localization language (we support US-hosted but need clarification on backups and cross-border processing). Who will own that thread at Redwood?

We’ve attached a (very small) annotated MSA excerpt — not a full redline yet — but it highlights the localization and subprocessor questions. Our legal lead, Paul Nguyen, will be the main reviewer.

If you can confirm owners and the 72h initial pass by EOD today, we’ll submit the full redline packet tomorrow morning.

Cheers,
Amelia Stone
Director of Product | ACME Health
amelia.stone@acmehealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Stone <amelia.stone@acmehealth.com>, Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, ACME Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: contract edit roster + proposed 72h TAT for legal redlines

Amelia / Paul — thanks and great to be aligned on the target close date. Confirming owners and commitments below (this will go into the MAP row and the shared Drive doc):

- Acknowledgement SLA: I will confirm receipt within 24 hours of the full packet.
- Redwood initial legal pass: Naomi Feldman (Head of Legal) — committed to 48–72 hours for a first-pass disposition from receipt of a complete packet (if the packet includes priority bullets and the annotated MSA). If Naomi needs >72h due to escalated privacy or indemnity issues, we will notify ACME and provide an estimate (expected +3–5 business days).
- Sales commercial responses & escalation: Ben Carter — will confirm commercial items / credits within 24 hours of Naomi’s pass and will escalate to me for approvals requiring credit beyond pre-approved limits.
- Technical / DPA controls & data localization: Karthik Iyer (Eng) — will own technical responses and confirm data residency/backup controls. If Karthik flags required product changes or custom work, we’ll add a dependency row to the MAP with an estimated engineering ETA.

Map milestone fields I’ll add: owner names, contact emails, acceptance criteria (signed MSA + DPA, agreed SLA table), start = receipt of redline packet, initial TAT = 72h, final counter negotiation window = 5 business days, fallback = Legal -> Jordan -> VP Sales.

Next steps for today:
- ACME: send full redline packet tomorrow morning (ACME indicated).
- Naomi: start timer on 72h after receipt.
- Ben: we’ll prep a short commercial leash (limits for credits) in case pricing discussion is required.
- Karthik: please scan the attached MSA excerpt today and flag any items likely to require >3 business days.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

--- Forwarded attachment stubs: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), MSA-redlines-acme.pdf (annotated excerpt)
